title: EcoFlow Delta Status State of Charge Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecoflow:delta soc_pct=*
| stats sum(soc_pct) as total_value, avg(soc_pct) as avg_value by device_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average state of charge across EcoFlow Delta status events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `soc_pct` values for each EcoFlow Delta status event and review total and average state of charge by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total state of charge.
grandmaExplanation: It honestly which device shows the biggest state of charge numbers in your EcoFlow Delta status data.
